skills.title: Story MV · 剧情 MV
skills.description: Write an original story for a song and shoot it in many short AI clips: a storyboard on the beat grid, first and last frames, Seedance 2.5 through Sumi Studio MCP, a film-look finish and lyric typography the agent never reads. 从故事、分镜到 4K 成片、署名卡和封面。

examples.title: HONG KONG · 猫猫 MV
examples.description: Nicky Li 与 Claude 通过 Sumi Studio MCP 制作。两只猫每晚守在九龙一个路口，等坐的士离开的她回来：69 个镜头，88 条 Seedance 2.5 片段。
examples.audioLabel: Silent web preview · full film · no lyrics · 720p

skills.title: White-model city film · 城市白模纪录短片
skills.description: Turn real building data into a city documentary with Three.js, historical maps, AI narration and a continuous score. 从真实建筑、历史地图到双语字幕与 4K 成片。

examples.title: 人家尽枕河 · Homes Pillowed on the River
examples.description: Nicky Li 与 Claude 通过 Sumi Studio MCP 制作。92,681 栋建筑与六千年的苏州故事：代码渲染城市画面，AI 生成旁白和配乐。
examples.audioLabel: Full film · 1080p · Mandarin narration + score · 中英字幕

skills.title: MV character recast
skills.description: Recreate a selected music-video sequence with approved characters, matched motion references and shot-by-shot review. 从角色、Depth与场景参考到局部返修和成片验收。

examples.title: Thriller, recast with AI characters
examples.description: DeepSeek leads a cast of AI characters through a 54-shot dance sequence. Depth guides movement; scene plates, identity references and local repairs shape the final film.
